text: Sri Eshwar College of Engineering (SECE) is a premier private engineering institution located in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. The college was established with the goal of providing quality technical education and grooming future industry leaders. SECE is affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which is one of the most prestigious technical universities in India. The institution is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi, ensuring that all its programs meet national educational standards. For the Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA) counseling process, SECE has been assigned the TNEA code 2739. The college is recognized for its student-centric approach, modern infrastructure, and strong commitment to placements and innovation, making it a highly sought-after engineering college in the region.

Sri Eshwar College of Engineering offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across various engineering and technology disciplines. The departments at SECE are designed to align with industry requirements and emerging technologies. The active departments include: - Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) - Computer Science and Engineering - Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (CSE-AIML) - Artificial Intelligence and Data Science (AI&DS) - Computer Science and Business Systems (CSBS) - Computer Science and Design / Computer Science and Engineering - Cyber Security (Cyber Security) - Computer and Communication Engineering (CCE) - Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) - Electronics and Communication Engineering - VLSI Design and Technology (VLSI) - Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE) - Information Technology (IT) - Mechanical Engineering (MECH) - Science and Humanities (S&H) - which handles the foundational sciences, mathematics, and English for first-year students. The Department of Mechanical Engineering (MECH) at Sri Eshwar College of Engineering offers a B.E. degree program affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. The department is equipped with advanced laboratories including a CAD/CAM lab, Fluid Mechanics lab, Thermal Engineering lab, Manufacturing Technology lab, and Metrology lab. The curriculum covers core subjects such as Engineering Thermodynamics, Manufacturing Processes, Strength of Materials, Machine Design, Fluid Mechanics, Heat Transfer, and Finite Element Analysis. Students are trained in the use of industry-standard tools like AutoCAD, SolidWorks, ANSYS, and CATIA. The department has experienced and dedicated faculty who guide students in research projects, design challenges, and industry internships. Mechanical Engineering students at SECE are placed in core manufacturing, automotive, and engineering service companies, as well as top IT firms. The department regularly organizes technical symposiums, workshops, and guest lectures by industry experts to keep students updated with the latest advancements in mechanical and manufacturing engineering.

The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) at Sri Eshwar College of Engineering is one of the largest and most active departments, offering B.E. in CSE along with specialized streams in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (CSE-AIML) and Cyber Security. The department is equipped with high-performance computing labs, networking labs, and dedicated AI/ML research labs. The curriculum covers programming languages (C, C++, Java, Python), data structures, algorithms, operating systems, database management, computer networks, software engineering, cloud computing, and machine learning. Students have access to platforms like AWS Academy, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud through institutional partnerships. The department achieves outstanding placement records with students joining top companies such as Zoho, Amazon, Wipro, TCS, Infosys, Cognizant, and Hexaware. Student clubs like the Coding Club, Cybersecurity Club, and AI Research Group conduct regular hackathons and coding contests.

The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) at Sri Eshwar College of Engineering offers B.E. in ECE along with a specialized stream in VLSI Design and Technology. The department is equipped with state-of-the-art labs including an Embedded Systems lab, Signal Processing lab, VLSI Design lab, Microprocessors lab, and RF and Antenna lab. The curriculum covers subjects like Digital Electronics, Signals and Systems, Communication Systems, Electromagnetic Theory, Microprocessors and Microcontrollers, VLSI Design, Wireless Communication, and Optical Communication. Students are trained in tools such as MATLAB, Cadence, Xilinx Vivado, and Multisim. The department has strong industry collaborations and its students are placed in semiconductor companies, telecom firms, defence organizations, and top IT companies.

Admissions to Sri Eshwar College of Engineering (SECE) for undergraduate B.E. and B.Tech courses are conducted primarily through two pathways: 1. Government Quota: Candidates can apply through the Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions (TNEA) single-window counseling system administered by the government. The TNEA code for Sri Eshwar College of Engineering is 2739. Selection is based on the cut-off marks obtained in the Higher Secondary (+2) examinations. 2. Management Quota: Candidates can also seek admission directly under the Management Quota based on their academic performance and eligibility criteria set by the management and Anna University. Admission for the academic year 2025 is currently open. Aspiring candidates can visit the official campus, register online via the admissions portal, or contact the administrative office to secure their seats. Eligible students can also apply for various merit-based scholarship schemes offered by the college.

The academic programs at Sri Eshwar College of Engineering follow the curriculum and regulations prescribed by Anna University, Chennai. The college currently implements both the Regulations 2021 (R2021) and Regulations 2023 (R2023) guidelines. These curricula focus on choice-based credit systems, outcome-based education, and interdisciplinary learning. To manage academic progress, attendance, internal assessment marks, timetables, and student profiles, the college utilizes a dedicated Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) portal. The ERP platform is accessible online at erp.sece.ac.in. Through the ERP portal, parents can track their ward's academic performance and attendance, and students can access digital learning materials, register for courses, and view their continuous assessment scores.

SECE hosts a dedicated Centre for Research to foster a strong research culture among faculty and students. The college actively encourages academic research, publications in reputed journals, and patent filings. The Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) cell at SECE assists researchers in filing patents and protecting their innovations. To kickstart research activities, the institution provides seed funds and internal research grants to faculty and students working on novel ideas. SECE has successfully secured multiple external research grants from government bodies like DST, AICTE, and DRDO. The college also undertakes industry-funded consultancy projects, bridging the gap between academic research and real-world industrial applications.

Innovation is a core pillar of Sri Eshwar College of Engineering. The college has established a vibrant Centre for Innovation which coordinates various student-led projects and technical initiatives. SECE has several Centres of Excellence (CoEs) set up in collaboration with top industry leaders (such as Virtusa, Cisco, and Intel) to train students on cutting-edge technologies. The Institution's Innovation Council (IIC) at SECE is registered under the Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell and conducts regular hackathons, coding contests, and ideation workshops. The Ignite Startup Accelerator is the college's dedicated incubation center that assists students in transforming their innovative ideas into commercial startups by providing mentoring, workspace, legal support, and access to angel investors.

The Centre for Training and Placements at Sri Eshwar College of Engineering is highly active and ensures that students are industry-ready. SECE has an outstanding placement record with students getting placed in top-tier multinational corporations and product companies. The placement cell provides structured training starting from the first year, which includes quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning, verbal ability, and soft skills training. The college organizes regular mock interviews, group discussions, and technical coding tests to build confidence in students. Top recruiters at SECE include major tech giants and core engineering companies such as Amazon, Zoho, Virtusa, Cognizant, Wipro, TCS, Infosys, Hexaware, and Soliton, offering high salary packages.

Sri Eshwar College of Engineering has established strong international alliances and global partnerships with leading foreign universities in the US, Europe, and Asia. These collaborations facilitate the Semester Abroad Program (SAP), allowing students to study a semester at partner universities overseas. The college supports students in securing international internships, enabling them to gain global work experience. SECE promotes both inward and outward mobility, encouraging international students to visit the campus and SECE students to participate in exchange programs. These initiatives ensure that students gain global exposure, understand diverse cultures, and prepare for international careers.

SECE boasts a modern, environment-friendly, and fully Wi-Fi enabled campus equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure. The facilities include: - Smart Classrooms: Classrooms are equipped with interactive smart boards, audio-visual systems, and ergonomic seating to enhance the teaching-learning experience. - Central Library: A vast digital library housing thousands of books, national and international journals, e-books, and online databases. - Sports Facilities: Excellent indoor and outdoor sports amenities, including cricket grounds, football fields, basketball courts, and a well-equipped gymnasium. - Hostel: Separate, safe, and comfortable hostel facilities for boys and girls with hygienic dining, study halls, and round-the-clock security. - Medical Facility: An on-campus health center with a resident doctor and ambulance facility for emergencies. - Transport: A fleet of buses connecting the campus to all major parts of Coimbatore and surrounding districts.

The campus is located at Kondampatti Post, Vadasithur (via), Kinathukadavu, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu - 641202. For general information or admissions help, students can reach out via the official contact numbers or emails listed on their official website.
